items.title: How Infinitas Learning uses ClickHouse Managed Postgres to process billions of events for 1.6M unique learners
items.summary: Infinitas Learning runs transactions for 1.6 million learners on ClickHouse Managed Postgres and serves real-time analytics to teachers from ClickHouse Cloud, where distributed cache cut P99 latency from about 13 seconds to 410 milliseconds.

items.title: What I learned from a month with WalShadow on ClickHouse Managed Postgres
items.summary: Hidehiko ASAHI shares a month of WalShadow private-preview testing, comparing replication latency with ClickPipes and checking data correctness, schema changes, and recovery.
